item.title: Hong Kong privacy watchdog contacts Elon Musk’s xAI over sexualised AI images of women and minors
item.description: Hong Kong’s privacy watchdog has contacted Elon Musk’s xAI over its Artificial Intelligence (AI) chatbot Grok, after netizens used it to create indecent content from photos or videos of real women and children. item.title: Hong Kong Film Awards’ organisers drop Best Asian Chinese Language Film category with no explanation
item.description: Organisers of the Hong Kong Film Awards (HKFA) have scrapped the Best Asian Chinese Language Film category without any explanation. The Best Asian Chinese Language Film category is no longer listed on the HKFA’s web page for this year’s awards. The HKFA refused to comment when contacted by HKFP on Thursday. item.title: 4 movies ‘disappear’ from Hong Kong Film Awards’ contenders list
item.description: Four movies have been excluded from the Hong Kong Film Awards’ (HKFA) contenders list this year with no explanation, sparking censorship concerns. item.title: Ming Pao to cease operations in Canada, last issues to be published Friday
item.description: Ming Pao newspaper will end its operations in Canada at the end of the month, citing financial concerns. item.description: Police fired live rounds to subdue a knife-wielding man at Tuen Mun Town Plaza on Thursday, police have told HKFP. The suspect later died in hospital. item.description: Hong Kong police have arrested a mainland Chinese student in connection with a HK$2.8 million scam spree involving the impersonation of fake officials, after she herself fell victim to the same ruse and was recruited as an accomplice.
